scope_note: Ten candidates include integrated hospital suites, clinical-record platforms, ambulatory EHRs, an LIS, and FHIR/openEHR infrastructure. These are distinct classes and the scores are use-case screening judgments, not an interchangeable product ranking or approval. No deployment, security, clinical-safety, privacy, certification, or regulatory validation was performed.

scoring_rubric.interpretation: Provisional desk-research screen only. Higher aggregate scores do not make ambulatory, laboratory, or infrastructure products substitutes for a complete hospital EHR/HMIS. Clinical safety, legal/regulatory compliance, privacy, and production readiness require separate validation.

records.name: Bahmni
records.care_scope: Integrated EMR/HIS combining registration, point-of-care records, investigations, billing and complementary laboratory, ERP and PACS components; Standard and Lite profiles differ.
records.license: MIT for bahmni-docker; wider distribution is multi-license.
records.license_notes: The MIT license covers this deployment repository only. Official FAQ describes Bahmni-specific components/modifications and deployment automation as generally AGPL-3.0, while integrated OpenMRS, OpenELIS, Odoo, JasperReports and DCM4CHEE components retain their version-specific licenses. Verify every component and version.
records.clinical_and_hospital_workflows: Official materials document registration, point-of-care, investigations and billing. Standard composes clinical, laboratory, ERP/billing and PACS products; exact admission, medication, encounter, order and imaging workflows depend on release/configuration and were not fully verified.
records.interoperability_data_model: Official page documents OpenMRS FHIR module support for R4 and DSTU3, plus component-specific ATOMFeed, HL7 v2 ORM/ORU, DICOM and terminology mappings. Confirm exact release, modules, profiles and conformance; no complete distribution-wide conformance established.
records.maintenance_security: Observed repository activity through 2026-10-07, but no formal GitHub releases. Project docs identify stable Lite image tag 1.0.0 and `latest` development images. Private vulnerability reporting is documented; end-to-end stack/dependency audit, permission matrix, audit coverage and encryption remain unverified.
records.arabic_localization_rtl: An official Arabic/RTL implementation account exists, but maintained inclusion in the reviewed Docker release, translation completeness and bidirectional behavior are unverified.
records.clinical_regulatory_evidence: An official ABDM certification claim was not independently established for scope, version or current validity. No scoped clinical-safety, HIPAA, GDPR or ONC evidence verified.
records.screening_judgment: Integrated hospital-stack candidate for further diligence; not a recommendation or validation of clinical performance, security, compliance or production readiness.
records.confidence: Moderate on product scope, repository license and documented composition; lower on release-specific controls, interoperability conformance, Arabic/RTL maintenance and regulatory scope.

records.name: OpenMRS
records.care_scope: Configurable clinical-record platform used in primary care, specialty programs and hospital implementations; core is not a turnkey hospital suite.
records.license_notes: Core license is file-level copyleft; separately licensed modules, terminologies, services, branding and implementation terms require review.
records.clinical_and_hospital_workflows: Core models patients, identifiers, visits, encounters, providers, locations and observations; documentation describes customizable forms, diagnosis tracking and orders. Appointments, queues, billing, inventory, labs and dispensing may depend on modules/integrations; inpatient admission/bed management and native PACS/DICOM were not established.
records.interoperability_data_model: Metadata/concept-dictionary-driven model, REST API and draft/local-build FHIR guide based on FHIR 4.0.1 with listed resources. No native HL7 v2, DICOM or specific LOINC/SNOMED/ICD binding/conformance verified.
records.maintenance_security: Release page showed 2.8.10 latest visible and 2.7.6 maintenance line, with current repository activity. Security policy requires private reporting and warns against testing on real patient-data systems. No independent dependency or penetration audit performed.
records.arabic_localization_rtl: Product materials claim configurable translation, multiple languages and RTL generally; Arabic completeness and module-level behavior require testing.
records.clinical_regulatory_evidence: No scoped HIPAA, GDPR, ONC or clinical-safety certification evidence for core was verified.
records.screening_judgment: Useful configurable clinical-record foundation for integration-oriented deployments; do not treat core alone as turnkey hospital EHR/HMIS.
records.confidence: Moderate on product scope, license, data model, APIs and release/activity evidence; implementation-specific workflow and control status remain uncertain.

records.name: GNU Health
records.care_scope: Broad modular hospital and health information system spanning clinical records and institutional operations within the larger GNU Health ecosystem.
records.license: GPL-3.0-or-later, as stated in canonical repository README.
records.license_notes: The exact LICENSE file could not be retrieved because of an anti-bot interstitial; record license from the repository's explicit README statement, not as independent inspection of that file. GPL licensing is not a commercial-use prohibition.
technology: installation routes include Ansible, packages, VM and embedded
records.clinical_and_hospital_workflows: Official project describes 40+ packages covering primary care, OB/GYN, pediatrics, surgery, laboratory information management, genetics, diagnostic imaging, dentistry, reporting, finance, billing, stock and pharmacy. Detailed order, medication-administration, imaging archive and encounter lifecycle completeness is unverified; do not conflate separate PHR/LIMS/federation components with this HIS.
records.interoperability_data_model: Official docs navigation lists FHIR REST, but the page was unavailable; version, resources and conformance unknown. No primary-source confirmation of HL7 v2, DICOM, LOINC, SNOMED CT or specific ICD version/coverage.
records.maintenance_security: Codeberg release history showed HIS 5.0.7 dated 2026-04-11 and prior 5.0.x activity. Security guide recommends production hardening; advisory index only surfaced a legacy 2016 entry, not a comprehensive current vulnerability/dependency audit.
records.arabic_localization_rtl: Localization and translation workflow exists; Arabic completeness and RTL usability unverified.
records.clinical_regulatory_evidence: No product/version/deployment-scoped certification or clinical-safety evidence verified; no HIPAA/GDPR/ONC conclusion inferred.
records.screening_judgment: Broad modular HMIS candidate to investigate; outstanding interoperability, security, operational, localization and clinical/regulatory questions prevent deployment assurance.
records.confidence: Moderate on scope, stated license and release evidence; lower on standards, security, operational detail and RTL because key official pages were unavailable or incomplete.

records.name: OpenEMR
records.category: Ambulatory / clinic EHR and practice management
records.care_scope: Patient records and medical-practice workflows including scheduling and billing; not established as an integrated inpatient hospital suite.
records.license_notes: Exact repository license is GPLv3. Third-party components and service/certification-linked terms need separate review; distribution boundaries may merit counsel.
records.clinical_and_hospital_workflows: Documents patient records, forms/notes, prescriptions, encounter coding, appointments, billing, lab orders/results and diagnostic-study workflows. No comprehensive inpatient ADT/bed management, hospital-wide orders or PACS/DICOM system verified.
records.interoperability_data_model: API guide documents FHIR R4 4.0.1, US Core 8.0, SMART 2.2.0, Bulk Data 2.0.0, USCDI v5, CCD-A, provenance and specific terminologies/exchanges. Sample CapabilityStatement identifies v7.0.4, so match claims to the intended release.
records.maintenance_security: Latest reviewed release v8.4.1 dated 2026-09-20; release notes and public advisories include critical/high/moderate issues such as authorization bypass, PHI exposure, SQL injection, SSRF and RCE. Patch promptly and assess the specific deployment; no deployment security is implied.
records.arabic_localization_rtl: Internationalization and translation administration are documented; Arabic completeness, clinical localization and RTL usability unverified.
records.clinical_regulatory_evidence: Project wiki claims version-8 ONC Health IT certification dated 2026-01-30 with scoped criteria and notes that it is not HHS endorsement; not blanket HIPAA/GDPR or clinical-safety evidence.
records.screening_judgment: Strong candidate for ambulatory/clinic EHR and practice-management evaluation only; score does not imply complete inpatient hospital coverage or safety.
records.confidence: Moderate-high on scope, license, release and published APIs; lower on deployed controls and current Arabic/RTL or jurisdiction-specific fitness.

records.name: OSCAR EMR
records.care_scope: Clinician-centered family-medicine and community-practice EMR in Canada; not a hospital-wide EHR/HMIS or LIS.
records.license: GNU General Public License version 2 (GPL-2.0) for public repository.
records.license_notes: McMaster distinguishes its public repository from the direct quality-managed source for some deployed OSCAR software. Verify exact variant, code and third-party license notices.
technology: Linux/Ubuntu hosting described in community docs
records.clinical_and_hospital_workflows: Community docs list patient charts, appointments, prescriptions, labs/imaging interfaces, forms, letters, fax, waitlists, reports and clinic workflows. Inpatient ADT, beds, operating room, blood bank, PACS/DICOM and complete hospital-wide system were not established.
records.interoperability_data_model: OSCAR Galaxy mentions HL7 communications and lab imports but not versions/profiles/transport/conformance. OSCAR Pro 1.18 mentions a FHIR API fix; that does not establish FHIR conformance for all public or commercial variants.
records.maintenance_security: Bitbucket metadata showed repository updated 2026-06-13, but branch/release relationship and commercial variant status need verification. No clearly discoverable canonical security policy or current dependency audit verified; vendor penetration-test statement applies to OSCAR Pro, not public repository.
records.arabic_localization_rtl: Spanish is mentioned as an example; Arabic localization and RTL are unverified.
records.clinical_regulatory_evidence: McMaster describes quality/regulatory context for affiliated/deployed work but evidence does not establish certification or clinical safety for the public repo/build. No HIPAA/GDPR/ONC status verified.
records.screening_judgment: Canadian ambulatory-clinic candidate; do not treat it as a complete hospital EHR/HMIS or infer variant-level quality assurance from the public repository.
records.confidence: Moderate for ambulatory scope and public license; lower for current runtime, support, deployed-source equivalence, standards and security posture.

records.name: OpenELIS Global
records.care_scope: Specialist clinical/public-health laboratory system for specimen collection, testing, results and lab networks; not general EHR.
records.license: MPL-2.0 per canonical 1.x repository API metadata; active Global 2 successor contains exact MPL-2.0 LICENSE file.
records.license_notes: Canonical OpenELIS Global 1.x repo is explicitly EOL and its LICENSE path was absent on current default branch. Keep license evidence for old repo distinct from the active Global 2 successor.
records.clinical_and_hospital_workflows: Documents registration, orders, specimen collection, traceability, testing, analyzer ingestion, results, QC, referrals and laboratory networks. Integration can exchange clinical results; this is not admission, medication, imaging or longitudinal EHR functionality.
records.interoperability_data_model: Active Global 2 materials claim FHIR R4 and publish an implementation guide; also HL7 v2.x over MLLP and ASTM instrument drivers/flat files. These are product/version-specific claims, not blanket conformance; no general DICOM, LOINC, SNOMED CT or ICD support established.
records.maintenance_security: Canonical 1.x repository last pushed in 2021 and EOL. Active successor showed release 3.2.1.11 and activity on evidence date, plus private vulnerability policy. Current production dependency/security audit not performed.
records.arabic_localization_rtl: Successor localization/translation activity exists, but Arabic translation completeness and RTL UI are unverified.
records.clinical_regulatory_evidence: No HIPAA, GDPR, ONC, software certification or clinical-safety certification verified. ISO 15189/SLIPTA references concern laboratory quality/accreditation support, not product certification.
records.screening_judgment: Specialist LIS candidate only; assess active Global 2 as a distinct successor, not the EOL requested 1.x repository.
records.confidence: Moderate on LIS scope, successor license and current activity; lower on old-repository license file, Arabic/RTL, security and regulatory status.

records.name: HAPI FHIR
records.care_scope: Java FHIR client/server, model and persistence libraries for developers building clinical applications; not a turnkey EHR/HMIS.
records.license_notes: Permissive software license subject to Apache terms/notices; commercial support is separate. License does not provide a turnkey product, compliance or clinical authorization.
records.clinical_and_hospital_workflows: Provides Patient models, REST APIs and persistence/search/terminology components, not ready-to-run admissions, encounters, orders, medication, lab, imaging, billing or hospital operations.
records.interoperability_data_model: Explicit HL7 FHIR implementation; version matrix lists multiple version pairings including DSTU1, DSTU2, DSTU3, R4, R4B and R5 for the reviewed HAPI release. Verify exact module/release pairing. Other named standards/profiles and conformance were not established.
records.maintenance_security: Release v8.8.2 dated 2026-09-25 with repo activity on evidence date. Security docs emphasize application-specific controls; starter has no security implementation or enterprise logging by default. CVE-2026-55470 is a specific fixed-vulnerability record, not a full security inventory.
records.arabic_localization_rtl: No official Arabic/RTL UI support verified; likely host application responsibility.
records.clinical_regulatory_evidence: No applicable HIPAA, GDPR, ONC or clinical-safety evidence verified.
records.screening_judgment: FHIR infrastructure building block for a team prepared to implement clinical applications, security and operations; not a hospital EHR.
records.confidence: Moderate for scope, license, documented APIs, database guidance and release evidence; lower for full security/dependency posture and deployment assurance.

records.name: EHRbase
records.care_scope: OpenEHR backend for storing and querying structured clinical records in another application; not a turnkey user-facing EHR or hospital suite.
records.license_notes: Apache-2.0 applies to repository source subject to terms/notices. Review dependencies, trademarks and separate support/maintenance services independently.
records.clinical_and_hospital_workflows: Documents EHRs, Compositions, Folders, Contributions, templates, queries and AQL. No admissions, orders, medications, labs, imaging, scheduling, billing or end-to-end hospital workflow product established.
records.interoperability_data_model: Implements versioned openEHR APIs/data model. Optional FHIR terminology-server validation does not establish general FHIR API/resource support. No HL7 v2, DICOM or specific terminology-system conformance verified.
records.maintenance_security: Latest reviewed release v2.36.0. Security policy exists; example installation starts without authentication, so configure auth, secrets and hardening. No independent dependency/SBOM audit or full vulnerability assessment performed.
records.arabic_localization_rtl: No official Arabic translation or RTL support verified.
records.clinical_regulatory_evidence: No HIPAA, GDPR, ONC, medical-device or clinical-safety certification verified.
records.screening_judgment: Relevant openEHR data infrastructure for a separate clinical application, not a complete hospital or ambulatory EHR.
records.confidence: Moderate for documented openEHR scope, license, stack and release; limited for application-level clinical workflows, controls, localization and regulatory assurance.

records.name: Medplum
records.care_scope: Developer platform for custom clinical apps/EHRs using FHIR; not one fixed turnkey hospital management product.
records.license: Apache-2.0 for most core platform components.
records.license_notes: Official page says most listed platform components are Apache-2.0; check each package/dependency and trademarks. Hosted monitoring, backup/DR, compliance support and related services are separate paid features.
records.clinical_and_hospital_workflows: FHIR resources, access policies and lab/imaging order/result examples support building custom clinical apps. ADT channel and imaging integrations show integration capabilities, not complete admission management, LIS or PACS.
records.interoperability_data_model: FHIR R4 4.0.1 API; examples include LOINC/SNOMED. Agent docs describe HL7 v2 MLLP, DICOM C-STORE/C-ECHO and ASTM alpha. These limited features do not establish comprehensive terminology coverage, full DICOM services or conformance across profiles.
records.maintenance_security: Active 5.1.x releases. Access policies and security disclosure policy documented; GHSA-w852-7r27-32c6 reports moderate SSRF fixed before 5.1.14. Self-hosters must patch and assess dependencies and controls.
records.arabic_localization_rtl: Arabic translation and RTL support unverified.
records.clinical_regulatory_evidence: ONC certification described as in progress in official CPOE guide. Hosted product security/compliance claims do not certify OSS or self-hosted deployment; no clinical-safety certification verified.
records.screening_judgment: Potential infrastructure base for custom FHIR clinical applications; not demonstrated to be a turnkey hospital EHR/HMIS.
records.confidence: Medium for scope, FHIR version, architecture, license and stated integrations; lower for real-world workflow completeness, security assurance and regulatory/localization status.

records.name: Open Hospital
records.care_scope: Facility-oriented hospital information management with patient records, OPD, admission/discharge, lab, pharmacy/stock, therapy and billing; not shown to be a large enterprise acute-care suite.
records.license_notes: Exact root license is GPL-3.0; separately review third-party notices, trademarks, support, hosting and bundled components.
technology: REST API and React UI components marked WIP
records.clinical_and_hospital_workflows: Official docs list patient registration, OPD, admissions/discharges, anamnesis, examination, lab results, pharmacy/stock, therapy, maternity, vaccines, billing, appointments and reporting. Inpatient order depth, full medication management and enterprise imaging were not established.
records.interoperability_data_model: No explicit FHIR, HL7, DICOM, LOINC, SNOMED CT, ICD or openEHR conformance found. Optional image viewer is not evidence of PACS/DICOM exchange; API is marked work in progress.
records.maintenance_security: Release v1.15.2 dated 2026-10-12 with recent commits. No SECURITY.md detected in reviewed GitHub view. Admin docs show default admin/admin and SINGLEUSER=yes; change/default hardening and network controls are essential before any real-data consideration. No independent security audit.
records.arabic_localization_rtl: Arabic listed as a supported language setting; complete translation and validated RTL behavior across forms/reports remain unverified.
records.clinical_regulatory_evidence: No HIPAA, GDPR, ONC, clinical safety or equivalent certification evidence verified.
records.screening_judgment: Integrated facility-system candidate for further fit and deployment diligence. Default credentials and non-production portable mode are material hardening cautions; do not advance solely on score.
records.confidence: Moderate for documented workflows, release and license; lower for standards, tests, privacy/security assurance, complete RTL support and regulatory status.
